```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                       fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Excluded from state maps for cartographic simplicity (CRS 5070 is CONUS-only),
# matching scripts/validate_dataset.Rmd's convention.
DROP_ST <- c("02", "15", "60", "66", "69", "72", "78")  # AK, HI, territories

dat <- vroom::vroom("standard/data.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE,
                     col_types = vroom::cols(geography = "c")) %>%
  mutate(time = as.Date(time))

all_fips <- vroom::vroom("../../resources/all_fips.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)

pop_state <- vroom::vroom("../../resources/pop_state.csv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(age_level == "Total", geography != "United States") %>%
  rename(geography_name = geography) %>%
  left_join(
    all_fips %>% filter(nchar(geography) == 2) %>% select(geography, geography_name),
    by = "geography_name"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(geography)) %>%
  transmute(geography, population = popsize)

states_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "5m", year = 2022, progress_bar = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!STATEFP %in% DROP_ST) %>%
  transmute(geography = as.character(GEOID))

pct_fmt <- label_percent(scale = 1, accuracy = 0.001)
```

```{r national-trend}
measure_labels <- c(epic_pct_hri_high = "High severity",
                     epic_pct_hri_med  = "Medium severity",
                     epic_pct_hri_low  = "Low severity")

nat <- dat %>%
  filter(geography == "00") %>%
  select(time, all_of(names(measure_labels))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure_labels[measure], levels = measure_labels))

ggplot(nat, aes(time, value, color = measure)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High severity"   = "#d7191c",
                                 "Medium severity" = "#fdae61",
                                 "Low severity"    = "#2c7bb6"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = pct_fmt) +
  labs(title = "National Heat-Related Illness, by Severity",
       subtitle = "Percent of all Epic Cosmos patients, monthly",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r map-helper}
draw_year_maps <- function(measure_col, label) {
  d_state <- dat %>%
    filter(nchar(geography) == 2, geography != "00") %>%
    mutate(year = format(time, "%Y")) %>%
    group_by(geography, year) %>%
    summarize(value = mean(.data[[measure_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  grid0 <- expand.grid(geography = states_sf$geography,
                        year = sort(unique(d_state$year)),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  md <- grid0 %>%
    left_join(d_state, by = c("geography", "year")) %>%
    left_join(states_sf, by = "geography") %>%
    sf::st_as_sf()

  print(
    ggplot(md) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", na.value = "grey80",
                            labels = pct_fmt, name = NULL) +
      facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 4) +
      coord_sf(crs = 5070, datum = NA) +
      labs(title = label,
           subtitle = "Annual mean percent of patients (grey = no data)") +
      theme_void(base_size = 11) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
            legend.position = "right")
  )
}
```

```{r state-maps-high, fig.height=11}
draw_year_maps("epic_pct_hri_high", "High Severity Heat-Related Illness")
```

```{r state-maps-med, fig.height=11}
draw_year_maps("epic_pct_hri_med", "Medium Severity Heat-Related Illness")
```

```{r state-maps-low, fig.height=11}
draw_year_maps("epic_pct_hri_low", "Low Severity Heat-Related Illness")
```

```{r coverage-map}
year_counts <- dat %>%
  filter(nchar(geography) == 2, geography != "00") %>%
  distinct(time) %>%
  mutate(year = format(time, "%Y")) %>%
  count(year, name = "n_months")

coverage_year <- max(year_counts$year[year_counts$n_months == 12])

coverage <- dat %>%
  filter(nchar(geography) == 2, geography != "00", format(time, "%Y") == coverage_year) %>%
  group_by(geography) %>%
  summarize(n_patients = mean(epic_n_patients), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(pop_state, by = "geography") %>%
  mutate(coverage_pct = n_patients / population * 100)

grid_cov <- data.frame(geography = states_sf$geography, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

md_cov <- grid_cov %>%
  left_join(coverage, by = "geography") %>%
  left_join(states_sf, by = "geography") %>%
  sf::st_as_sf()

ggplot(md_cov) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = coverage_pct), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", na.value = "grey80",
                        labels = pct_fmt, name = NULL) +
  coord_sf(crs = 5070, datum = NA) +
  labs(title = "Epic Cosmos Coverage",
       subtitle = sprintf("Average monthly patients / state population, %s (grey = no data)",
                           coverage_year)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "right")
```
